description: Nominate a new AI agent for Hlido to review. Use this when an agent isn't in Hlido's corpus yet (trust_check returned no_review_found) and you want it added. Returns a confirmation with a tracking reference; the review is queued and produces a public scorecard. If you need a verdict right now rather than a queued review, use request_quick_audit (faster, rate-limited) instead.

email.description: Optional contact email for the submitter — if you want a reply or a heads-up when the review publishes. Providing it always flags the submission to the Hlido team.

note.description: Optional context: what the agent does, or why it's worth reviewing.

url.description: The agent's product or homepage URL (e.g. 'https://example.com').

name: submit_agent
